claim_verdicts.evidence: ThemeExtension: "An interface that defines custom additions to a ThemeData object." ThemeData.extensions: "Arbitrary additions to this theme." "To define extensions, pass an Iterable containing one or more ThemeExtension subclasses to ThemeData.new or copyWith."

Flutter 3.47.2 SDK theme_data.dart:993 `T? extension<T>() => extensions[T] as T?;` and :1817-1825 the stored map's key is `extension.type` (ThemeExtension.type => T). A missing key yields null. API doc: "Obtain with Theme.of(context).extension<MyThemeExtension>()."

theme_data.dart (3.47.2): `abstract class ThemeExtension<T extends ThemeExtension<T>>` with bodiless `ThemeExtension<T> copyWith();` and `ThemeExtension<T> lerp(covariant ThemeExtension<T>? other, double t);`. Doc comment: "implement the [copyWith] and [lerp] methods".

app.dart:1056-1060: unless themeAnimationStyle is noAnimation, MaterialApp wraps in AnimatedTheme with themeAnimationDuration (default kThemeAnimationDuration = 200 ms). ThemeDataTween.lerp => ThemeData.lerp; _lerpThemeExtensions calls `extensionA.lerp(extensionB, t)` for each extension of the old theme. Tween.transform returns `end` at t == 1.0.

Tween.transform: "returns begin and end when the animation values are 0.0 or 1.0", otherwise lerp(t). For 0<t<1 ThemeData.lerp -> _lerpThemeExtensions -> extensionA.lerp(extensionB, t): a lerp returning `this` keeps the old set until t == 1.0, then the new theme is used as is (one step). A throwing lerp throws inside AnimatedTheme's build on the first intermediate frame.

extension<T>() is `extensions[T] as T?` (3.47.2 SDK), so with no StatusColors registered it returns null; status_banner.dart:32 applies `!` to it before the tone switch, so every tone fails at build time. The `!` is a run-time null check (Flutter release notes record run-time 'Null check operator used on a null value' errors); nothing in the type system flags it at compile time.
